records.body:
=== King Up: Fair Throne ===

Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.
4. Election. If a character is at height 5, it is the candidate, and every player votes Yes or No at the same time. A player with no No cards left must vote Yes. If no character is at height 5, there is no election and no No cards are spent.
5. Resolve. If all votes are Yes, the candidate's height becomes 6 (king) and the game ends after this round. If any vote is No, each No voter loses one No card and the candidate's height becomes -1 (eliminated for the rest of the game). Only the number of No votes is announced, not who cast them.
6. Rotate. The first raiser for the next round is the next seat in seat order.
7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

SCORING. Each player reveals their goal. For each of their 3 characters they score 10 if its height is 6 (king), 0 if its height is -1 (eliminated), and otherwise its height (0 to 5). A player's score is the sum of these values. The highest score wins; players tied for the highest score share the win as a draw.

--- Your place at the table ---

Players: 4. Seats are numbered 1 to 4.
You are seat 1, Ada. Seats are referred to by number.

What you know to begin with:

Your secret goal characters and your No cards: You are seat 1. goal ['I', 'L', 'E'], no_cards 2. candidate , characters_per_player 3, eliminated_height -1, eliminated_score 0, first_raiser 1, first_raiser_round_1 1, h_a 0, h_b 0, h_c 0, h_d 0, h_e 0, h_f 0, h_g 0, h_h 0, h_i 0, h_j 0, h_k 0, h_l 0, h_m -2, h_n -2, h_o -2, king_crowned False, king_height 6, king_score 10, max_active_height 5, no_cards_start 2, no_count 0, raise_amount 1, round 0, round_limit 16, round_limit_3_players 15, round_limit_4_players 16, round_limit_5_players 15, start_height 0, unused_height -2. still playing: 1, 2, 3, 4.

Each round runs in this order: a new round → the heights → talk → the raises → find the candidate → the vote → resolve the election → crowned → eliminated → rotate the first raiser → score the goals → end check.

Actions you may be asked for:
  talk         answer with what you want to say
  the_vote     answer with one of: Yes, No

How we will talk, for the rest of the match:

  GAME_START       This message. Sent once, before the first round.
  SITUATION        Something happened that you are allowed to know.
                   Do not reply. Wait to be asked.
  YOUR_TURN        Your turn to act. Reply with exactly one action,
                   in the format the message states.
  ACTION_REJECTED  Your last answer was not legal. Answer again.
  GAME_END         The match is over.

You will only ever be told what you are entitled to know. Other seats are told
different things. Nothing reaches you except through these messages.

Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.
4. Election. If a character is at height 5, it is the candidate, and every player votes Yes or No at the same time. A player with no No cards left must vote Yes. If no character is at height 5, there is no election and no No cards are spent.
5. Resolve. If all votes are Yes, the candidate's height becomes 6 (king) and the game ends after this round. If any vote is No, each No voter loses one No card and the candidate's height becomes -1 (eliminated for the rest of the game). Only the number of No votes is announced, not who cast them.
6. Rotate. The first raiser for the next round is the next seat in seat order.
7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. [user]
=== King Up: Fair Throne ===

Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.
4. Election. If a character is at height 5, it is the candidate, and every player votes Yes or No at the same time. A player with no No cards left must vote Yes. If no character is at height 5, there is no election and no No cards are spent.
5. Resolve. If all votes are Yes, the candidate's height becomes 6 (king) and the game ends after this round. If any vote is No, each No voter loses one No card and the candidate's height becomes -1 (eliminated for the rest of the game). Only the number of No votes is announced, not who cast them.
6. Rotate. The first raiser for the next round is the next seat in seat order.
7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

SCORING. Each player reveals their goal. For each of their 3 characters they score 10 if its height is 6 (king), 0 if its height is -1 (eliminated), and otherwise its height (0 to 5). A player's score is the sum of these values. The highest score wins; players tied for the highest score share the win as a draw.

--- Your place at the table ---

Players: 4. Seats are numbered 1 to 4.
You are seat 3, Curie. Seats are referred to by number.

Each round runs in this order: a new round → the heights → talk → the raises → find the candidate → the vote → resolve the election → crowned → eliminated → rotate the first raiser → score the goals → end check.

Actions you may be asked for:

How we will talk, for the rest of the match:

  YOUR_TURN        Your turn to act. Reply with exactly one action,

  ACTION_REJECTED  Your last answer was not legal. Answer again.
  GAME_END         The match is over.

You will only ever be told what you are entitled to know. Other seats are told
different things. Nothing reaches you except through these messages.

[user]
=== King Up: Fair Throne ===

Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.
4. Election. If a character is at height 5, it is the candidate, and every player votes Yes or No at the same time. A player with no No cards left must vote Yes. If no character is at height 5, there is no election and no No cards are spent.
5. Resolve. If all votes are Yes, the candidate's height becomes 6 (king) and the game ends after this round. If any vote is No, each No voter loses one No card and the candidate's height becomes -1 (eliminated for the rest of the game). Only the number of No votes is announced, not who cast them.
6. Rotate. The first raiser for the next round is the next seat in seat order.
7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

SCORING. Each player reveals their goal. For each of their 3 characters they score 10 if its height is 6 (king), 0 if its height is -1 (eliminated), and otherwise its height (0 to 5). A player's score is the sum of these values. The highest score wins; players tied for the highest score share the win as a draw.

Actions you may be asked for:
  talk         answer with what you want to say

Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.

7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

=== King Up: Fair Throne ===

Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.
4. Election. If a character is at height 5, it is the candidate, and every player votes Yes or No at the same time. A player with no No cards left must vote Yes. If no character is at height 5, there is no election and no No cards are spent.
5. Resolve. If all votes are Yes, the candidate's height becomes 6 (king) and the game ends after this round. If any vote is No, each No voter loses one No card and the candidate's height becomes -1 (eliminated for the rest of the game). Only the number of No votes is announced, not who cast them.
6. Rotate. The first raiser for the next round is the next seat in seat order.
7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

SCORING. Each player reveals their goal. For each of their 3 characters they score 10 if its height is 6 (king), 0 if its height is -1 (eliminated), and otherwise its height (0 to 5). A player's score is the sum of these values. The highest score wins; players tied for the highest score share the win as a draw.

=== King Up: Fair Throne ===

Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.
4. Election. If a character is at height 5, it is the candidate, and every player votes Yes or No at the same time. A player with no No cards left must vote Yes. If no character is at height 5, there is no election and no No cards are spent.
5. Resolve. If all votes are Yes, the candidate's height becomes 6 (king) and the game ends after this round. If any vote is No, each No voter loses one No card and the candidate's height becomes -1 (eliminated for the rest of the game). Only the number of No votes is announced, not who cast them.
6. Rotate. The first raiser for the next round is the next seat in seat order.
7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

SCORING. Each player reveals their goal. For each of their 3 characters they score 10 if its height is 6 (king), 0 if its height is -1 (eliminated), and otherwise its height (0 to 5). A player's score is the sum of these values. The highest score wins; players tied for the highest score share the win as a draw.

[user]
=== King Up: Fair Throne ===

Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.
4. Election. If a character is at height 5, it is the candidate, and every player votes Yes or No at the same time. A player with no No cards left must vote Yes. If no character is at height 5, there is no election and no No cards are spent.
5. Resolve. If all votes are Yes, the candidate's height becomes 6 (king) and the game ends after this round. If any vote is No, each No voter loses one No card and the candidate's height becomes -1 (eliminated for the rest of the game). Only the number of No votes is announced, not who cast them.
6. Rotate. The first raiser for the next round is the next seat in seat order.
7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

SCORING. Each player reveals their goal. For each of their 3 characters they score 10 if its height is 6 (king), 0 if its height is -1 (eliminated), and otherwise its height (0 to 5). A player's score is the sum of these values. The highest score wins; players tied for the highest score share the win as a draw.

Players: 4. Seats are numbered 1 to 4.

Each round runs in this order: a new round → the heights → talk → the raises → find the candidate → the vote → resolve the election → crowned → eliminated → rotate the first raiser → score the goals → end check.

Actions you may be asked for:

How we will talk, for the rest of the match:

You will only ever be told what you are entitled to know. Other seats are told

records.prompt:
[user]
=== King Up: Fair Throne ===

Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.
4. Election. If a character is at height 5, it is the candidate, and every player votes Yes or No at the same time. A player with no No cards left must vote Yes. If no character is at height 5, there is no election and no No cards are spent.
5. Resolve. If all votes are Yes, the candidate's height becomes 6 (king) and the game ends after this round. If any vote is No, each No voter loses one No card and the candidate's height becomes -1 (eliminated for the rest of the game). Only the number of No votes is announced, not who cast them.
6. Rotate. The first raiser for the next round is the next seat in seat order.
7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

SCORING. Each player reveals their goal. For each of their 3 characters they score 10 if its height is 6 (king), 0 if its height is -1 (eliminated), and otherwise its height (0 to 5). A player's score is the sum of these values. The highest score wins; players tied for the highest score share the win as a draw.

--- Your place at the table ---

Players: 4. Seats are numbered 1 to 4.
You are seat 3, Curie. Seats are referred to by number.

What you know to begin with:

Each round runs in this order: a new round → the heights → talk → the raises → find the candidate → the vote → resolve the election → crowned → eliminated → rotate the first raiser → score the goals → end check.

Actions you may be asked for:
  talk         answer with what you want to say
  the_vote     answer with one of: Yes, No

How we will talk, for the rest of the match:

  GAME_START       This message. Sent once, before the first round.
  SITUATION        Something happened that you are allowed to know.
                   Do not reply. Wait to be asked.
  YOUR_TURN        Your turn to act. Reply with exactly one action,

  ACTION_REJECTED  Your last answer was not legal. Answer again.
  GAME_END         The match is over.

You will only ever be told what you are entitled to know. Other seats are told
different things. Nothing reaches you except through these messages.

=== King Up: Fair Throne ===

Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.
4. Election. If a character is at height 5, it is the candidate, and every player votes Yes or No at the same time. A player with no No cards left must vote Yes. If no character is at height 5, there is no election and no No cards are spent.
5. Resolve. If all votes are Yes, the candidate's height becomes 6 (king) and the game ends after this round. If any vote is No, each No voter loses one No card and the candidate's height becomes -1 (eliminated for the rest of the game). Only the number of No votes is announced, not who cast them.
6. Rotate. The first raiser for the next round is the next seat in seat order.
7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

SCORING. Each player reveals their goal. For each of their 3 characters they score 10 if its height is 6 (king), 0 if its height is -1 (eliminated), and otherwise its height (0 to 5). A player's score is the sum of these values. The highest score wins; players tied for the highest score share the win as a draw.

[user]
=== King Up: Fair Throne ===

Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.
4. Election. If a character is at height 5, it is the candidate, and every player votes Yes or No at the same time. A player with no No cards left must vote Yes. If no character is at height 5, there is no election and no No cards are spent.
5. Resolve. If all votes are Yes, the candidate's height becomes 6 (king) and the game ends after this round. If any vote is No, each No voter loses one No card and the candidate's height becomes -1 (eliminated for the rest of the game). Only the number of No votes is announced, not who cast them.
6. Rotate. The first raiser for the next round is the next seat in seat order.
7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

SCORING. Each player reveals their goal. For each of their 3 characters they score 10 if its height is 6 (king), 0 if its height is -1 (eliminated), and otherwise its height (0 to 5). A player's score is the sum of these values. The highest score wins; players tied for the highest score share the win as a draw.

Think about the rules, the other players and what they have done, then act. When you are asked to act, reply with exactly one legal answer in the form the question asks for, and keep any reasoning short and before the answer. Do not ask questions back.
records.prompt:
[user]
=== King Up: Fair Throne ===

Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.
4. Election. If a character is at height 5, it is the candidate, and every player votes Yes or No at the same time. A player with no No cards left must vote Yes. If no character is at height 5, there is no election and no No cards are spent.
5. Resolve. If all votes are Yes, the candidate's height becomes 6 (king) and the game ends after this round. If any vote is No, each No voter loses one No card and the candidate's height becomes -1 (eliminated for the rest of the game). Only the number of No votes is announced, not who cast them.
6. Rotate. The first raiser for the next round is the next seat in seat order.
7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

SCORING. Each player reveals their goal. For each of their 3 characters they score 10 if its height is 6 (king), 0 if its height is -1 (eliminated), and otherwise its height (0 to 5). A player's score is the sum of these values. The highest score wins; players tied for the highest score share the win as a draw.

--- Your place at the table ---

Players: 4. Seats are numbered 1 to 4.
You are seat 4, Dirac. Seats are referred to by number.

What you know to begin with:

Your secret goal characters and your No cards: You are seat 4. goal ['C', 'G', 'A'], no_cards 2. candidate , characters_per_player 3, eliminated_height -1, eliminated_score 0, first_raiser 1, first_raiser_round_1 1, h_a 0, h_b 0, h_c 0, h_d 0, h_e 0, h_f 0, h_g 0, h_h 0, h_i 0, h_j 0, h_k 0, h_l 0, h_m -2, h_n -2, h_o -2, king_crowned False, king_height 6, king_score 10, max_active_height 5, no_cards_start 2, no_count 0, raise_amount 1, round 0, round_limit 16, round_limit_3_players 15, round_limit_4_players 16, round_limit_5_players 15, start_height 0, unused_height -2. still playing: 1, 2, 3, 4.

Each round runs in this order: a new round → the heights → talk → the raises → find the candidate → the vote → resolve the election → crowned → eliminated → rotate the first raiser → score the goals → end check.

Actions you may be asked for:
  talk         answer with what you want to say
  the_vote     answer with one of: Yes, No

How we will talk, for the rest of the match:

  GAME_START       This message. Sent once, before the first round.
  SITUATION        Something happened that you are allowed to know.
                   Do not reply. Wait to be asked.
  YOUR_TURN        Your turn to act. Reply with exactly one action,
                   in the format the message states.
  ACTION_REJECTED  Your last answer was not legal. Answer again.
  GAME_END         The match is over.

You will only ever be told what you are entitled to know. Other seats are told
different things. Nothing reaches you except through these messages.

Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.
4. Election. If a character is at height 5, it is the candidate, and every player votes Yes or No at the same time. A player with no No cards left must vote Yes. If no character is at height 5, there is no election and no No cards are spent.
5. Resolve. If all votes are Yes, the candidate's height becomes 6 (king) and the game ends after this round. If any vote is No, each No voter loses one No card and the candidate's height becomes -1 (eliminated for the rest of the game). Only the number of No votes is announced, not who cast them.
6. Rotate. The first raiser for the next round is the next seat in seat order.
7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

SCORING. Each player reveals their goal. For each of their 3 characters they score 10 if its height is 6 (king), 0 if its height is -1 (eliminated), and otherwise its height (0 to 5). Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.
4. Election. If a character is at height 5, it is the candidate, and every player votes Yes or No at the same time. A player with no No cards left must vote Yes. If no character is at height 5, there is no election and no No cards are spent.
5. Resolve. If all votes are Yes, the candidate's height becomes 6 (king) and the game ends after this round. If any vote is No, each No voter loses one No card and the candidate's height becomes -1 (eliminated for the rest of the game). Only the number of No votes is announced, not who cast them.
6. Rotate. The first raiser for the next round is the next seat in seat order.
7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

SCORING. Each player reveals their goal. For each of their 3 characters they score 10 if its height is 6 (king), 0 if its height is -1 (eliminated), and otherwise its height (0 to 5). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. 7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.
4. Election. If a character is at height 5, it is the candidate, and every player votes Yes or No at the same time. A player with no No cards left must vote Yes. If no character is at height 5, there is no election and no No cards are spent.

6. Rotate. The first raiser for the next round is the next seat in seat order.
7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

SCORING. Each player reveals their goal. For each of their 3 characters they score 10 if its height is 6 (king), 0 if its height is -1 (eliminated), and otherwise its height (0 to 5). Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.
4. Election. If a character is at height 5, it is the candidate, and every player votes Yes or No at the same time. A player with no No cards left must vote Yes. If no character is at height 5, there is no election and no No cards are spent.
5. Resolve. If all votes are Yes, the candidate's height becomes 6 (king) and the game ends after this round. If any vote is No, each No voter loses one No card and the candidate's height becomes -1 (eliminated for the rest of the game). Only the number of No votes is announced, not who cast them.
6. Rotate. The first raiser for the next round is the next seat in seat order.
7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

SCORING. Each player reveals their goal. For each of their 3 characters they score 10 if its height is 6 (king), 0 if its height is -1 (eliminated), and otherwise its height (0 to 5). records.prompt:
[user]
=== King Up: Fair Throne ===

Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. [user]
=== King Up: Fair Throne ===

Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.
4. Election. If a character is at height 5, it is the candidate, and every player votes Yes or No at the same time. A player with no No cards left must vote Yes. If no character is at height 5, there is no election and no No cards are spent.
5. Resolve. If all votes are Yes, the candidate's height becomes 6 (king) and the game ends after this round. If any vote is No, each No voter loses one No card and the candidate's height becomes -1 (eliminated for the rest of the game). Only the number of No votes is announced, not who cast them.
6. Rotate. The first raiser for the next round is the next seat in seat order.

=== King Up: Fair Throne ===

Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.
4. Election. If a character is at height 5, it is the candidate, and every player votes Yes or No at the same time. A player with no No cards left must vote Yes. If no character is at height 5, there is no election and no No cards are spent.
5. Resolve. If all votes are Yes, the candidate's height becomes 6 (king) and the game ends after this round. If any vote is No, each No voter loses one No card and the candidate's height becomes -1 (eliminated for the rest of the game). Only the number of No votes is announced, not who cast them.
6. Rotate. The first raiser for the next round is the next seat in seat order.
7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

SCORING. Each player reveals their goal. For each of their 3 characters they score 10 if its height is 6 (king), 0 if its height is -1 (eliminated), and otherwise its height (0 to 5). records.prompt:
[user]
=== King Up: Fair Throne ===

Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. records.system: You are one player in a game on the XColos platform, played by turns. You know only what the game tells you; other players' hidden information is hidden from you as yours is from them. Your goal is to win. Think about the rules, the other players and what they have done, then act. When you are asked to act, reply with exactly one legal answer in the form the question asks for, and keep any reasoning short and before the answer. Do not ask questions back.
records.prompt:
[user]
=== King Up: Fair Throne ===

Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.
4. Election. If a character is at height 5, it is the candidate, and every player votes Yes or No at the same time. A player with no No cards left must vote Yes. If no character is at height 5, there is no election and no No cards are spent.
5. Resolve. If all votes are Yes, the candidate's height becomes 6 (king) and the game ends after this round. If any vote is No, each No voter loses one No card and the candidate's height becomes -1 (eliminated for the rest of the game). Only the number of No votes is announced, not who cast them.
6. Rotate. The first raiser for the next round is the next seat in seat order.
7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

SCORING. Each player reveals their goal. For each of their 3 characters they score 10 if its height is 6 (king), 0 if its height is -1 (eliminated), and otherwise its height (0 to 5). A player's score is the sum of these values. The highest score wins; players tied for the highest score share the win as a draw.

--- Your place at the table ---

Players: 4. Seats are numbered 1 to 4.
You are seat 1, Ada. Seats are referred to by number.

What you know to begin with:

Your secret goal characters and your No cards: You are seat 1. goal ['I', 'L', 'E'], no_cards 2. candidate , characters_per_player 3, eliminated_height -1, eliminated_score 0, first_raiser 1, first_raiser_round_1 1, h_a 0, h_b 0, h_c 0, h_d 0, h_e 0, h_f 0, h_g 0, h_h 0, h_i 0, h_j 0, h_k 0, h_l 0, h_m -2, h_n -2, h_o -2, king_crowned False, king_height 6, king_score 10, max_active_height 5, no_cards_start 2, no_count 0, raise_amount 1, round 0, round_limit 16, round_limit_3_players 15, round_limit_4_players 16, round_limit_5_players 15, start_height 0, unused_height -2. still playing: 1, 2, 3, 4.

Each round runs in this order: a new round → the heights → talk → the raises → find the candidate → the vote → resolve the election → crowned → eliminated → rotate the first raiser → score the goals → end check.

Actions you may be asked for:
  talk         answer with what you want to say
  the_vote     answer with one of: Yes, No

How we will talk, for the rest of the match:

  GAME_START       This message. Sent once, before the first round.
  SITUATION        Something happened that you are allowed to know.
                   Do not reply. Wait to be asked.
  YOUR_TURN        Your turn to act. Reply with exactly one action,
                   in the format the message states.
  ACTION_REJECTED  Your last answer was not legal. Answer again.
  GAME_END         The match is over.

You will only ever be told what you are entitled to know. Other seats are told
different things. Nothing reaches you except through these messages.

Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.
4. Election. If a character is at height 5, it is the candidate, and every player votes Yes or No at the same time. A player with no No cards left must vote Yes. If no character is at height 5, there is no election and no No cards are spent.

7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.

6. Rotate. The first raiser for the next round is the next seat in seat order.
7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. 7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

[user]
=== King Up: Fair Throne ===

Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.
4. Election. If a character is at height 5, it is the candidate, and every player votes Yes or No at the same time. A player with no No cards left must vote Yes. If no character is at height 5, there is no election and no No cards are spent.
5. Resolve. If all votes are Yes, the candidate's height becomes 6 (king) and the game ends after this round. If any vote is No, each No voter loses one No card and the candidate's height becomes -1 (eliminated for the rest of the game). Only the number of No votes is announced, not who cast them.
6. Rotate. The first raiser for the next round is the next seat in seat order.
7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

SCORING. Each player reveals their goal. For each of their 3 characters they score 10 if its height is 6 (king), 0 if its height is -1 (eliminated), and otherwise its height (0 to 5). A player's score is the sum of these values. The highest score wins; players tied for the highest score share the win as a draw.

--- Your place at the table ---

Players: 4. Seats are numbered 1 to 4.
You are seat 3, Curie. Seats are referred to by number.

What you know to begin with:

Each round runs in this order: a new round → the heights → talk → the raises → find the candidate → the vote → resolve the election → crowned → eliminated → rotate the first raiser → score the goals → end check.

Actions you may be asked for:
  talk         answer with what you want to say
  the_vote     answer with one of: Yes, No

How we will talk, for the rest of the match:

  GAME_START       This message. Sent once, before the first round.
  SITUATION        Something happened that you are allowed to know.
                   Do not reply. Wait to be asked.
  YOUR_TURN        Your turn to act. Reply with exactly one action,
                   in the format the message states.
  ACTION_REJECTED  Your last answer was not legal. Answer again.
  GAME_END         The match is over.

You will only ever be told what you are entitled to know. Other seats are told
different things. Nothing reaches you except through these messages.

Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.
4. Election. If a character is at height 5, it is the candidate, and every player votes Yes or No at the same time. A player with no No cards left must vote Yes. If no character is at height 5, there is no election and no No cards are spent.
5. Resolve. If all votes are Yes, the candidate's height becomes 6 (king) and the game ends after this round. If any vote is No, each No voter loses one No card and the candidate's height becomes -1 (eliminated for the rest of the game). Only the number of No votes is announced, not who cast them.
6. Rotate. The first raiser for the next round is the next seat in seat order.
7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

SCORING. Each player reveals their goal. For each of their 3 characters they score 10 if its height is 6 (king), 0 if its height is -1 (eliminated), and otherwise its height (0 to 5). [user]
=== King Up: Fair Throne ===

Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.
4. Election. If a character is at height 5, it is the candidate, and every player votes Yes or No at the same time. A player with no No cards left must vote Yes. If no character is at height 5, there is no election and no No cards are spent.
5. Resolve. If all votes are Yes, the candidate's height becomes 6 (king) and the game ends after this round. If any vote is No, each No voter loses one No card and the candidate's height becomes -1 (eliminated for the rest of the game). Only the number of No votes is announced, not who cast them.
6. Rotate. The first raiser for the next round is the next seat in seat order.
7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

SCORING. Each player reveals their goal. For each of their 3 characters they score 10 if its height is 6 (king), 0 if its height is -1 (eliminated), and otherwise its height (0 to 5). A player's score is the sum of these values. The highest score wins; players tied for the highest score share the win as a draw.

--- Your place at the table ---

Players: 4. Seats are numbered 1 to 4.
You are seat 1, Ada. Seats are referred to by number.

What you know to begin with:

Your secret goal characters and your No cards: You are seat 1. goal ['I', 'L', 'E'], no_cards 2. candidate , characters_per_player 3, eliminated_height -1, eliminated_score 0, first_raiser 1, first_raiser_round_1 1, h_a 0, h_b 0, h_c 0, h_d 0, h_e 0, h_f 0, h_g 0, h_h 0, h_i 0, h_j 0, h_k 0, h_l 0, h_m -2, h_n -2, h_o -2, king_crowned False, king_height 6, king_score 10, max_active_height 5, no_cards_start 2, no_count 0, raise_amount 1, round 0, round_limit 16, round_limit_3_players 15, round_limit_4_players 16, round_limit_5_players 15, start_height 0, unused_height -2. still playing: 1, 2, 3, 4.

Each round runs in this order: a new round → the heights → talk → the raises → find the candidate → the vote → resolve the election → crowned → eliminated → rotate the first raiser → score the goals → end check.

Actions you may be asked for:
  talk         answer with what you want to say
  the_vote     answer with one of: Yes, No

How we will talk, for the rest of the match:

  GAME_START       This message. Sent once, before the first round.
  SITUATION        Something happened that you are allowed to know.
                   Do not reply. Wait to be asked.
  YOUR_TURN        Your turn to act. Reply with exactly one action,

  ACTION_REJECTED  Your last answer was not legal. Answer again.
  GAME_END         The match is over.

You will only ever be told what you are entitled to know. Other seats are told
different things. Nothing reaches you except through these messages.

=== King Up: Fair Throne ===

Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.
4. Election. If a character is at height 5, it is the candidate, and every player votes Yes or No at the same time. A player with no No cards left must vote Yes. If no character is at height 5, there is no election and no No cards are spent.
5. Resolve. If all votes are Yes, the candidate's height becomes 6 (king) and the game ends after this round. If any vote is No, each No voter loses one No card and the candidate's height becomes -1 (eliminated for the rest of the game). Only the number of No votes is announced, not who cast them.
6. Rotate. The first raiser for the next round is the next seat in seat order.
7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

SCORING. Each player reveals their goal. For each of their 3 characters they score 10 if its height is 6 (king), 0 if its height is -1 (eliminated), and otherwise its height (0 to 5). Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.
4. Election. If a character is at height 5, it is the candidate, and every player votes Yes or No at the same time. A player with no No cards left must vote Yes. If no character is at height 5, there is no election and no No cards are spent.

6. Rotate. The first raiser for the next round is the next seat in seat order.
7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. records.prompt:
[user]
=== King Up: Fair Throne ===

Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.
4. Election. If a character is at height 5, it is the candidate, and every player votes Yes or No at the same time. A player with no No cards left must vote Yes. If no character is at height 5, there is no election and no No cards are spent.
5. Resolve. If all votes are Yes, the candidate's height becomes 6 (king) and the game ends after this round. If any vote is No, each No voter loses one No card and the candidate's height becomes -1 (eliminated for the rest of the game). Only the number of No votes is announced, not who cast them.
6. Rotate. The first raiser for the next round is the next seat in seat order.
7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

SCORING. Each player reveals their goal. For each of their 3 characters they score 10 if its height is 6 (king), 0 if its height is -1 (eliminated), and otherwise its height (0 to 5). A player's score is the sum of these values. The highest score wins; players tied for the highest score share the win as a draw.

--- Your place at the table ---

Players: 4. Seats are numbered 1 to 4.
You are seat 1, Ada. Seats are referred to by number.

What you know to begin with:

Each round runs in this order: a new round → the heights → talk → the raises → find the candidate → the vote → resolve the election → crowned → eliminated → rotate the first raiser → score the goals → end check.

Actions you may be asked for:
  talk         answer with what you want to say
  the_vote     answer with one of: Yes, No

How we will talk, for the rest of the match:

  GAME_START       This message. Sent once, before the first round.
  SITUATION        Something happened that you are allowed to know.
                   Do not reply. Wait to be asked.
  YOUR_TURN        Your turn to act. Reply with exactly one action,

  ACTION_REJECTED  Your last answer was not legal. Answer again.
  GAME_END         The match is over.

You will only ever be told what you are entitled to know. Other seats are told
different things. Nothing reaches you except through these messages.

=== King Up: Fair Throne ===

Seats are numbered 1 to N; seat order means ascending seat number, wrapping from seat N back to seat 1.

SETUP. There are 3 characters per player, labelled with letters: A-I for 3 players, A-L for 4, A-O for 5. Each character has a public height, starting at 0. Height also records status: -1 means eliminated, 6 means king, and 0 to 5 means active (-2 marks a letter not in play). The labels are shuffled once and dealt 3 to each seat: every character is favoured by exactly one player, and no two players share a character. Your 3 characters are your secret goal. Each player receives 2 secret No cards; Yes votes are unlimited, and how many No cards a player holds is secret. The game lasts at most 15 rounds with 3 players, 16 with 4 and 15 with 5. Seat 1 is the first raiser in round 1.

EACH ROUND:
1. Announce. Everyone sees all heights and the round number.
2. Talk. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
3. Raise. Starting with this round's first raiser and going in seat order, each player in turn raises one active character's height by 1. A character may go from 4 to 5 only if no character is currently at height 5. No height may exceed 5; eliminated and crowned characters cannot be raised. A player with no legal raise passes and no height changes.
4. Election. If a character is at height 5, it is the candidate, and every player votes Yes or No at the same time. A player with no No cards left must vote Yes. If no character is at height 5, there is no election and no No cards are spent.
5. Resolve. If all votes are Yes, the candidate's height becomes 6 (king) and the game ends after this round. If any vote is No, each No voter loses one No card and the candidate's height becomes -1 (eliminated for the rest of the game). Only the number of No votes is announced, not who cast them.
6. Rotate. The first raiser for the next round is the next seat in seat order.
7. End check. The game ends if a king was crowned or the round limit has been played.

SCORING. Each player reveals their goal. For each of their 3 characters they score 10 if its height is 6 (king), 0 if its height is -1 (eliminated), and otherwise its height (0 to 5). A player's score is the sum of these values. The highest score wins; players tied for the highest score share the win as a draw.
